title: 第17章 信士数量暴涨四村合一第18章 辖区扩张兄妹鬼魂
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
看着李有鸣一副三十多岁的模样。
张荣贵心中满是震惊。
说起来李有鸣年龄比他还大两岁。
但现在两人走在一起，简直就差了一辈的感觉。
当真神恩如海！
他心中感叹，面上却神色肃穆，向着李有鸣行了一礼：
“庙祝大人，张家村村长张荣贵，率领张家村村民前来拜祭彰越公，我张家村打算并入四海村！”
“俺廖家村也一样！”
中年模样的廖金志连忙道。
“哈哈——”
“欢迎张家村、廖家村的加入！
从此都是四海村村民，子子孙孙永受彰越公庇佑！”
李有鸣大笑了一声，开口道。
他心中也有些激动。
四村在这片区域都一百多年了。
想不到今天，他李有鸣居然让四村合一。
“子子孙孙永受彰越公庇佑！”
张荣贵、廖金志，以及跟在后面的大量两村村民都喜笑颜开。
有神只庇佑。
在这个世道中，他们再也不用担心哪一天被妖魔吃了！

浩浩荡荡——
大量村民向着土地庙而去。
到了土地庙附近。
一个个村民，包括四海村的村民都拿出了清香，点燃恭敬拜下。
“四海村全体村民，感谢彰越公斩杀狼妖，护佑我等！”
李有鸣大声道，恭敬叩首。
“感谢彰越公斩杀狼妖，护佑我等！”
李德阳、李修武、陈麻子、陈二狗、张荣贵、廖金志以及所有村民大声道。
声音浩荡，带着一抹庄严肃穆，飘出很远。
……
「神域」中。
李越看着土地庙外乌泱泱跪着的一大片村民。
他嘴角浮现了一抹笑意。
他能感觉到——
今天一天时间自己多出了大量信士。
而且很多信士的信仰层次都在提升！
斩杀狼妖，这就是最强力的神迹。
也是让所有村民受益的大事。
更为大量村民报了血仇。
“真实存在的神只、为村民斩妖的神只、给信士赐福的神只。”

“这样的神只谁不愿意信仰？”
“特别是在这个妖魔邪祟遍地的世界。”
他轻笑了一声。
打开「信士信息」看了看。
……
content_en:
Looking at Li Youming, he looked like he was in his thirties.
Zhang Ronggui was filled with shock.
Speaking of which, Li Youming is two years older than him.
But now that the two of them are together, they feel like they are a generation apart.
God’s grace is truly like an ocean!
He sighed in his heart, but with a solemn expression on his face, he saluted Li Youming:
"Master Miao Zhu, Zhang Ronggui, the head of Zhangjia Village, led the villagers of Zhangjia Village to pay homage to Zhang Yue Gong. Our Zhangjia Village plans to be merged into Sihai Village!"
"The same goes for me in Liaojia Village!"
The middle-aged Liao Jinzhi said quickly.
"Haha——"
“Welcome Zhangjiacun and Liaojiacun to join us!
From then on, we are all villagers of Sihai Village, and our children and grandchildren will always be protected by Duke Zhangyue! "
Li Youming laughed loudly and said.
He was also a little excited.
The four villages have been in this area for more than a hundred years.
Unexpectedly, today, he, Li Youming, would unite four villages into one.
"My descendants will always be protected by Duke Zhangyue!"
Zhang Ronggui, Liao Jinzhi, and a large number of villagers from the two villages who followed behind were all smiling.
God only protects you.
In this world, they no longer have to worry about being eaten by monsters one day!
Vast and mighty——
A large number of villagers went to the Tutu Temple.
Arrived near the Earth Temple.
Every villager, including those in Sihai Village, took out incense, lit it and bowed in reverence.
"All the villagers in Sihai Village would like to thank Mr. Zhang Yue for killing the wolf demon and protecting us!"
Li Youming said loudly and kowtowed respectfully.
"Thank you Duke Zhangyue for killing the wolf demon and protecting us!"
Li Deyang, Li Xiuwu, Chen Mazi, Chen Ergou, Zhang Ronggui, Liao Jinzhi and all the villagers shouted loudly.
The voice was loud and solemn, floating far away.
…
In "God's Domain".
Li Yue looked at the large group of kneeling villagers outside the Tutu Temple.
A smile appeared on his lips.
He could feel-
Today, I have gained a large number of believers.
And the level of faith of many believers is improving!
Killing the wolf demon is the most powerful miracle.
It is also a major event that benefits all villagers.
A large number of villagers were avenged.
"A real god, a god that kills demons for the villagers, a god that blesses believers."
"Who doesn't want to believe in such a god?"
"Especially in this world where evil spirits are everywhere."
He chuckled.
I opened "Believers' Information" and took a look.
…
